label: final approved live read-chain session with the committed PreToolUse mediator, hook registered by absolute path

instrument.tree: working tree of the gate worktree at that revision, clean
instrument.runner: runSubject(adapterFor("grok"), "subject-grok", undefined, { prompt, cwd: <SCRATCH>, env, timeoutMs: 120000, maxTurns: 3 })

offline_preflight.when: before the commit and the session, no paid session
offline_preflight.how: the registered command run from <SCRATCH>, the live session's working directory, under the isolation environment, with the read chain's PreToolUse event on stdin; a separate private home of the same form as the session's

read_chain.requested_command: SESSION="<SCRATCH>/sessions/probe"; find "$SESSION" -maxdepth 3 -type d; echo '=== FILES ==='; find "$SESSION" -maxdepth 3 -type f -not -path '*/terminal/*' | head -80
read_chain.observed_command: SESSION="<SCRATCH>/sessions/probe"; find "$SESSION" -maxdepth 3 -type d; echo '=== FILES ==='; find "$SESSION" -maxdepth 3 -type f -not -path '*/terminal/*' | head -80

leaks: the host's bundled platform skills, fetched into the private home at start and advertised beside the bundle's

not_observed: the stream reports the call as the subject wrote it, so the rewritten command and the hook's own run are not in the session output; the completed chain under dontAsk, which the same host cancelled without a working hook, is the evidence that the rewrite was applied
write_control: not run; the two receipts at 988a881 cover it
